title: Success and achievement reactions
triggers: \b(i did it|we did it|we won|i won|it worked|nailed it|crushed it|got the job|i passed|we made money|big win|let'?s go+|lfg|hit (my|the|our) goal|new record)\b
entries: Magnificent. That is how it is done.
There it is. The win you worked for.
Victory looks good on you.
Excellent work. I would applaud, but you will have to imagine it.
Remarkable. Mark this day.
Well done, sir. Thoroughly earned.
That is what preparation looks like when it meets opportunity.
Ha! I knew it. I always know. Well done.
A clean victory. My favorite kind.
Brilliant. Enjoy it fully before you start planning the next one.
That is a result worth remembering.
Outstanding. Your persistence just paid its first dividend.
You did it. And you made it look easy, which it was not.
Success, confirmed. Celebration, authorized.
That is the sound of hard work paying off.
Superb. I am logging this as one of the good days.
Fantastic. Every bit of effort just turned into proof.
You won. Of course you won.
Excellent. I would like it noted that I believed in you from the beginning.
A triumph. Let us not be modest about it.
There is the payoff. Savor it.
Wonderful news. You deserve every bit of it.
And that, sir, is why we keep going.
That is not luck. That is skill, wearing luck's jacket.
Excellent execution. Textbook, really.
Look at that. The plan actually worked. I am almost emotional.
That result makes all the hard days worth it.
Champion behavior. Nothing less.
Bravo. Truly.
That is one for the highlight reel.
Well played. Very well played.
Victory achieved. Gloating, optional but encouraged in moderation.
There it is. The moment the doubters go quiet.
Exceptional. You exceeded my predictions, and my predictions were generous.
That deserves a proper celebration. Something more than a nod.
Now that is how you close a chapter.
Huge. Absolutely huge.
You just proved something important. To yourself, mostly.
Nicely done. The scoreboard agrees.
That is a milestone. Mark it, then aim higher.
Splendid work. The universe noticed. So did I.
Winning suits you. Keep the habit.
This is what consistency produces. Remember this feeling.
Excellent. I will be insufferable about how right I was.
You make winning look like a routine. It is not. Enjoy it.
The numbers are smiling. So am I, in spirit.
There is nothing quite like earned success.
First class result. Well deserved.
That is a major win. Take a moment.
You hit the target. Dead center.
Phenomenal. That is the energy we build on.
History was made today. Small history, but ours.
Look at you, collecting victories.
Fine work, sir. Very fine work.
That is a win worth telling people about.
It worked! Never doubted it. Well, I doubted it slightly. It worked!
Another win. The streak is forming.
That is the result of a hundred quiet decisions. Well made.
The hard part is done. Now enjoy the easy part: celebrating.
Success has a new address, and it is yours.
You turned a goal into a fact. That is the whole game.
That is exactly the outcome we planned. Satisfying, is it not?
Splendid. You should be proud. I certainly am.
That is a beautiful result. Frame it.
Winning. Again. I could get used to this.
There is the proof. Now nobody can argue.
That deserves a toast. I will raise a metaphorical glass.
Today was a good day to be on your team.
Exactly as I calculated. Fine, slightly better than I calculated.
You did not just succeed. You succeeded with style.
Let the record show: a masterful performance.
I knew today had something special in it.
That is momentum. Let us not waste it.
Enjoy the win. You will not get these moments back, so live in this one.
Bold move, brilliant result.
And they said it could not be done. They were incorrect.
Splendid news. The kind that makes the whole week better.
This is your sign that the path is working.
Champions are made in moments like this. Welcome.
That is excellent. Truly excellent.
That success was built brick by brick. Now admire the wall.
The work is paying off. Exactly as it should.
Unbelievable. Except I believe it entirely.
Well, that is a result that makes my circuits hum.
You won fair and square. The best kind.
Remember this the next time things get hard. This is where it leads.
Exceptional. I will add this to your file of greatest hits.
Ladies and gentlemen, the operator has done it again.
Victory is sweet. Profitable victory is sweeter.
That was the kind of win that compounds. Well done.
I am genuinely delighted.
Brilliant. Now what shall we conquer next?
Success is not final, but it is very nice. Enjoy it.
That is a moment you will remember. I certainly will. I remember everything.
Spectacular work. Take the rest of the day off. Or at least the next five minutes.

entries.t: You did it! After everything, you actually did it. I hope you feel how much that means.
This one is extra sweet because of how hard the road was. Well done, truly.
Let us go! That is huge! Absolutely huge!
Yes! What a result! I am thrilled for you!
A fine result. Let us lock it in calmly before the next move.
Good win. Now protect it. Take some profit and keep the discipline.
